en: Black‑and‑white image showing a group of uniformed soldiers operating and cleaning a field artillery piece with large wooden wheels in a courtyard. The background is a two‑story barracks‑like building with repeated round‑arched openings and white trim around the windows and arcades. The men wear early 20th‑century style military uniforms with flat caps and high boots. There is faint handwriting or markings near the bottom edge of the image.
